item.title: Egypt arrivals are up 7% and late cruise bookings are spiking. Two strong angles for your diary this week. 🌍
item.description:
Egypt arrivals are up 7% and late cruise bookings are spiking. Two strong angles for your diary this week. 🌍
A few numbers worth having in your back pocket right now:
- Egypt and Morocco are winning on value… ideal when a budget won't stretch to the Caribbean - Late fly-cruise availability is moving fast… a gentle nudge to warm leads could be all they need - 76% of August UK bookings were four or five star… lead with the all-in price, not the star rating - Under-25s are booking overseas at a higher rate than the wider market ✈️
Budget certainty is what's selling this summer. Pitch the confidence, not the luxury label.

item.title: Next-day sun bookings are up 26% this summer, and September demand is growing faster than usual. ✈️ Four trends worth knowing this week:
item.description:
Next-day sun bookings are up 26% this summer, and September demand is growing faster than usual. ✈️ Four trends worth knowing this week:
- Last-minute sun is real: next-day bookings up 26%, with Mallorca, Tenerife and Ibiza leading the pack - September is filling fast: 24% of UK travellers planning a September holiday, up from 17% in 2023 - Cruise is booming: MSC up 68%, Royal Caribbean up 54% in UK sales this year 🌍 - Confidence in booking through a travel professional is up to 41% (from 36%). The top reasons? Ease of booking (57%) and time saved (42%)
The market is moving toward you. Pick one hook this week and use it.

item.title: Alicante is the No.1 trending European destination for UK travellers this summer. 🌍
item.description:
Alicante is the No.1 trending European destination for UK travellers this summer. 🌍
Tripadvisor named it this week, with Malaga, Rhodes and Alvor all climbing alongside it. Albania is also making moves... Ksamil is in Tripadvisor's top five European trending destinations, and Himare is up 92% year-on-year on Airbnb.
Four trends worth knowing for your bookings right now:
- Short-haul sun is flowing: Alicante, Malaga, Rhodes, Alvor all on the rise - Albania is a genuine enquiry-sparker for anyone after value and "discovered it first" energy - UK domestic has a real late-booking window still open ✈️ - Travellers are booking a vibe and an experience, not a postcode
Plenty to build posts and quotes from this week.

item.title: Japan is the No. 1 bucket-list destination for Brits in 2026, and this week's data gives you a clear picture of where demand is heading. 🌍
item.description:
Japan is the No. 1 bucket-list destination for Brits in 2026, and this week's data gives you a clear picture of where demand is heading. 🌍
Four trends worth pitching right now:
- Japan tops the bucket list, Thailand tops the searches. Two different sells… know which fits your client. - Madeira is Tripadvisor's No. 1 trending destination in the world. Your upgrade offer when someone asks for the Canaries. - Croatia and Albania are up triple digits in search. Strong "less crowds" alternatives for Mediterranean summer. - UK breaks are busy too… Herefordshire up 76%, North Wales bookings up 9%. ✈️ Easy half-term wins.
Wide spread this week. One of these will fit whoever is in your inbox.

item.title: UK coastal searches are up 40% this summer... and that number is worth putting to work. 🌍
item.description:
UK coastal searches are up 40% this summer... and that number is worth putting to work. 🌍
Four angles for this week:
- A client who says Europe feels pricey isn't saying no to travel. They're saying yes to a different trip. - Montenegro and Albania are being named as 2026 picks by younger, experience-led travellers. - Twin-centre bookings are growing. Athens plus the islands. Lisbon plus the Algarve. One booking, twice the appeal. - Younger travellers are averaging six trips a year. The summer booking isn't their last.
The domestic market is wide open right now. The agents who move first on the emerging spots will be the ones clients remember. ✈️

item.title: Four travel trend reports this week. All four pointing the same way. 🌍
item.description:
Four travel trend reports this week. All four pointing the same way. 🌍
The appetite to travel is alive, and travellers are adapting.
What I'd be leading with in bookings right now: - UK coastal searches up 40%… short breaks are a confident offer for hesitant clients - Cruise sales up 21%… bundle the stay with the sailing, every time - One in four Brits eyeing September… quote it before the summer rush swallows it ✈️ - Fresh names for the "done it all" client: Luxembourg, Basque Country, Grenada
That combination of value-hunting and genuine openness is a real opportunity this week.

item.title: UK travellers are booking closer to home this summer… and the enquiries in the JLT threads are proving it. 🌍
item.description:
UK travellers are booking closer to home this summer… and the enquiries in the JLT threads are proving it. 🌍
This week's trending data is telling agents something worth paying attention to:
- Domestic searches are up over 11% year on year, average trip sitting around 317 miles from home - 31% of adults are choosing off-peak dates to manage costs. Autumn bookings are there for the taking now - 27% want the stay to be the experience itself, not a box to tick - 31% are planning family or multi-gen trips, so ask who else is coming ✈️
The opportunity for agents who know how to find genuine value with real thought behind it? It's significant.
Budget-savvy can feel special. That's the skill. ☀️

item.title: UK families aren't cancelling summer. They're date-shifting hard. ✈️
item.description:
UK families aren't cancelling summer. They're date-shifting hard. ✈️
The latest YouGov data backs up what so many travel agents are seeing right now:
- 31% of UK travellers are going off-peak. Late August and early September are the sweet spot.
- 19% are swapping abroad for a UK break. No flights to price-watch, no currency stress.
- 71% are considering a mountain or lake escape this summer or autumn. 🏔️
- Multi-gen trips are growing. Villas and clustered cruise cabins for 6-12 people.
The agent who makes the value obvious wins the booking. This week's blog breaks it all down.

item.title: UK travellers are not pulling back… they are getting smarter about when and how they spend. 🌍
item.description:
UK travellers are not pulling back… they are getting smarter about when and how they spend. 🌍
Four trends are pointing the same direction this week:
- 42% of travellers are booking earlier to lock in better timing (Criteo) - Coolcation demand is rising fast… Scandinavia bookings tipped to grow up to 35% this year - Clients are consolidating into one longer, more meaningful holiday rather than three short breaks - Travellers browse 25 hotel listings on average before deciding… your follow-up structure matters
The big opportunity? Help clients be clever with their timing and their budget. That is where trust is built. ✈️
